name: Kankakee Airsoft Factory
description: 7-story factory building with CQB floors + outdoor area. Hosted by MiR Tactical. Open plays Mar–Nov.

name: MiR Tactical HQ — Buffalo Grove
description: Midwest's largest airsoft retailer & event organizer. Hosts Tier 1–3 events nationwide, many held in IL.

name: Bing Field Airsoft & Paintball Park
description: St. Louis area's premier facility. 60+ acres, 5+ acre City of Bedlam urban field. Monthly Big Games $30.

name: Joker's Circus Airsoft
description: Indiana's oldest active airsoft field, founded 1998. Annual Noob Day, MilSim events, open plays year-round.

name: Center Mass Airsoft
description: Woodland field offering open plays and MilSim events. Popular with the Indianapolis airsoft community.

name: Blastcamp — Hobart
description: Historic Nike Missile Base, 23 acres near the IL border. Cobra Airsoft Legion ops monthly. Walk-on $30, full ops $40–45.

name: Kalamazoo Airsoft
description: Michigan's premier indoor/outdoor CQB facility. Home field for WolfPack Airsoft. Unique terrain mix.

name: Hell Survivors
description: 180-acre complex with 12 fields. Hosts Global Conquest, the Monster Game, and Tippmann World Challenge annually.

name: Motor City Airsoft
description: Realistic indoor CQB airsoft field. Currently rebuilding at new location (16 Mile & Gratiot).

name: Twin Cities Airsoft (TCA)
description: Minnesota's premier scenario field. High Intensity Airsoft events monthly. Bio BB only. Giant Games 2x yearly.

name: Crossfire Airsoft
description: Oldest & best airsoft field in Minnesota. 30+ acres dedicated to airsoft only. 5 distinct fields, weekly games.

name: i70 Paintball & Airsoft
description: Most popular & well-reviewed field in Ohio. Bring-your-own-gear focus with rentals. Diverse terrain.

name: Devil's Playground Airsoft
description: Southern Ohio outdoor field near Cincinnati. Wooded terrain with varied game zones.

name: Cedar Airsoft Field
description: ~10 acres with woods, open field, CQB structures. Rec days every Sat ($20). Multiple game modes. Bio BBs available.

name: Hole in the Wall Paintball
description: Wooded & rugged courses with high ridges, thick forests, water obstacles. One of the toughest fields in the Midwest.

name: Legacy Paintball and Airsoft Park
description: Established paintball & airsoft park in the southwest Chicago suburbs. Open play and group events.

name: Urban Warfare Paintball
description: Central Illinois field offering urban-style paintball and airsoft scenarios. Open play and events.

name: Saltfork Paintball
description: East-central Illinois paintball & airsoft field. Wooded terrain with multiple game zones.

name: Sinnissippi Airsoft
description: Rod & Gun Club-hosted airsoft field in northwest Illinois. Community-run with regular game days.

name: Paintball Explosion (PBX)
description: Northwest Chicago suburb field running paintball & airsoft. Multiple field layouts, walk-on friendly.

name: Ronin Airsoft Home Field
description: Team-run private airsoft field in western Illinois. Community events and organized game days.

name: HTK Airsoft
description: Southern Indiana airsoft field. Regular game days and community events in Dubois County.

name: Sektor7 Airsoft
description: 40-acre airsoft-only field on Lake Erie. Dedicated airsoft terrain with regular game days.

name: The Den Airsoft
description: Airsoft-only field in the Tuscarawas Valley. Open only on posted dates: night games, open play and DenOp MilSims.

name: Splatter Park
description: Central Ohio paintball & airsoft park. Multiple field layouts for all skill levels, open play friendly.

name: Patriots Ridge Airsoft
description: West-central Ohio airsoft field. Patriot-themed field with woodland terrain and MilSim-focused events.

name: Parkers Airsoft Field
description: Southwest Ohio airsoft field near Cincinnati. Open play and organized events on wooded terrain.

name: Fallen Warrior Airsoft
description: 100-acre airsoft field in south-central Ohio. Large-scale MilSim ops and open play on expansive terrain.

name: Big Pearl Paintball
description: Northeast Ohio paintball & airsoft field near Lake Erie. Wooded terrain and multiple course layouts.

name: TC Paintball North
description: 55-acre northern Michigan paintball & airsoft complex. Large wooded terrain with multiple field zones.

name: Futureball
description: 35+ years running — one of Michigan's oldest continuously operating paintball and airsoft fields.

name: DarkFire Airsoft
description: South Michigan airsoft field. Woodland terrain and regular game days for the southern MI community.

name: Michigan Tactical Airsoft Center (MTAC)
description: 15,000 sqft indoor CQB arena in the Detroit metro. Large-scale indoor airsoft with realistic urban environments.

name: West Michigan Airsoft
description: West Michigan community-run airsoft field. Regular game days serving the Grand Rapids area.

name: Special Forces Paintball
description: West Metro Minnesota paintball & airsoft field. Woodland and speedball layouts west of the Twin Cities.

name: Champion Valley Park

name: Big Lake Tactical Wargames
description: MBA (Minnesota's Best Airsoft) monthly big games. 100+ players, objective-based scenario ops, vehicles, free camping Fri/Sat nights. Hosts Op Nightshade and year-round events.

name: Action Sports Wisconsin
description: Massive 80-acre complex with 40 shipping containers creating unique urban environments. One of the most unique fields in the Midwest.

name: Airsoft Arena
description: Wisconsin's largest indoor airsoft facility at 40,000 sqft. Year-round CQB gameplay in Milwaukee's largest arena.

name: Commando Paintball
description: Northeast Wisconsin paintball & airsoft field. Wooded courses near Green Bay with regular open play.

name: Edge Paintball and Airsoft
description: South Wisconsin field serving the Janesville/Beloit area. Open play and events with multiple terrain types.

name: So Go Airsoft
description: Southwest Missouri airsoft field near Springfield. Open play and events in Christian County.

name: The Rock Airsoft
description: Central Missouri airsoft field. Outdoor terrain with regular game days for the southwest MO community.

name: MASS — Missouri Airsoft Simulation Site
description: Northwest Missouri MilSim-focused airsoft field. Dedicated simulation site with scenario-based ops.

name: Huckleberry Ridge Airsoft
description: Southwest Missouri airsoft in the Ozarks. Rugged wooded terrain near the Arkansas border, unique natural environment.
